text: Redeem via App Link/paste fails silently when logged out

Done in ef4dc2d. Built on T-31's session-resume/startDestination rework exactly
as this ticket's fix hint suggested. Flow: logged-out redeem -> RedeemViewModel
stashes the token in PendingInviteHolder (in-memory @Singleton) + sets
needsLogin (no API call) -> RedeemScreen routes to Login -> after login,
LoginViewModel.startDestinationAfterLogin() consumes the token -> redeem/<token>
-> RedeemScreen redeems with the fresh session -> opens the list. Unit-tested
both halves; full debug suite + lintDebug green.

Not emulator-verified (folds into T-29): the actual OS App-Link intent ->
NavHost deep-link -> this flow end-to-end. Also the RedeemDialog (drawer) path
is unaffected — it's only reachable while already logged in.

Minor edge (documented, low risk): if a user parks a token then abandons login
without the process dying, the token lingers in the in-memory holder and would
be consumed by their NEXT successful login (redeeming a possibly-expired invite
-> harmless "expired" screen). In practice the app was just launched by the link
and isn't backgrounded during login; a process death clears the holder.
